name: Blackwater River + Coldwater Creek Experience
included: Camping, catered breakfasts and dinners, daily lunch snacks, river maps and evening programs. Cabins at Blackwater Joe's are optional and extra.
cabinsNote: Optional cabins: contact Blackwater Joe's at 850-803-2267 for your own cabin rental, at your own cost.
outfitter: Blackwater Joe's Canoe & Kayak Rentals (official outfitter). For rentals, email janice@paddleflorida.org.

overview.title: Two rivers, one week
overview.text: Paddle part of the Florida Canoe Trail on the Blackwater River, with white sandbars, high bluffs and tea-colored water, then finish on spring-fed Coldwater Creek. Two nights at Blackwater River State Park, in partnership with Florida State Parks, give you a full day to explore the beaches.
minis: Length of the Blackwater River, from southern Alabama to Blackwater Bay
Typical current on cold, clear, shallow Coldwater Creek
Paddling and layover days, tent camping

days.title: Arrive and settle in
days.body: Check in from 1 to 5 PM at Blackwater Joe's, a camp with a beach and river access. Set up your tent, then dinner at 6 PM, a trip orientation (attendance is required) and an evening program at 7 PM.

days.title: Through Blackwater River State Forest
days.body: A shuttle takes you to the put-in, then you paddle about 10 miles back to camp. Expect high bluffs, shady canopy, tea-colored water and white sandbars for picnics. A good day for beginners.

days.title: To Blackwater River State Park
days.body: Paddle about 10 miles downriver to the state park, where you camp for two nights.
days.cap: The striking beaches at Blackwater River State Park

days.title: Layover day
days.body: A rest day at the park, in partnership with Florida State Parks. Explore the beaches, or take an optional 5-mile paddle.

days.title: To Coldwater Creek
days.body: About 10 miles to the Coldwater Creek Recreational Area in Blackwater River State Forest, with clean restrooms and showers at camp.

days.title: South to Bob's Canoe Landing
days.body: After breakfast, pack up and load the gear truck, then paddle about 12 miles south. Coldwater Creek is mostly spring-fed, cold, clear and shallow, with a current of 3+ mph and few motorboats.

days.title: The final stretch to Milton
days.body: The last section of Coldwater Creek to Carpenter's Park in Milton, which calls itself the Canoe Capital of Florida.

camps.name: Blackwater Joe's
camps.note: Beach and river access. Optional cabins, booked and paid separately.

camps.name: Blackwater River State Park
camps.note: Two nights, with a layover day for the beaches.

camps.name: Coldwater Creek Recreational Area
camps.note: Blackwater River State Forest. Clean restrooms and showers.

camps.name: Bob's Canoe Landing
camps.note: Last camp. Gear goes on the truck each morning.

boat: Sit-in kayak, sit-on-top kayak or paddleboard, at least 12 feet. Basic paddling and swimming skills and moderately good fitness.
baggage: Two bags and 40 pounds in total. Bags ride the gear truck each day. Label them with your name.
water: Non-inflatable Coast Guard-approved PFD, worn on the water
Bow line, 8 to 10 ft, secured so it cannot come loose
Grab loops at bow and stern
First aid kit in a waterproof cover
Repair kit (duct tape, sealant, waterproof tape)
Rain gear and a fleece or light jacket
Dry change of clothes in a waterproof bag
Water for the day and snacks (lunch is provided)
land: Something to read, music or earplugs
faq: Dinner at 6 PM and an evening program at 7 PM. Programs include authors, historians and environmental experts, regional plants, animals and ecology, and one night of live music.
Open to all skill levels. Paddlers under 18 must be with a parent or guardian, with no more than two children under 12 per adult. A signed waiver and emergency contact are required. No pets.
What are the rules on the water?
Wear a non-inflatable PFD at all times. People-powered boats only. Follow park rules, including the alcohol ban, and respect private property along the river.
All payments are non-refundable, including for weather and water levels. Paddle Florida strongly recommends buying trip cancellation insurance from an outside provider.
Yes. Final details are emailed 7 to 10 days before the trip.
